test_title: PYST 27: SSC CHSL 2023 - Quantitative Aptitude(Held On: 10 Aug, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: maths
question: A manufacturer marked an item at ₹75 and sold it allowing a 14% discount. If his profit was 29%, then the cost price (in ₹) of the item was:
solution:
**Given:**

Marked price (M.P) = Rs.75

Discount% = 14%

Profit% = 29%

**Formula used:**

C.P/M.P = (100 - D)%/(100 + P)%

Where, C.P = cost price ; D = discount

and P = profit 

**Calculation:**

⇒ C.P/M.P = (100 - D)%/(100 + P)%

⇒ C.P/75 = (100 - 14)/(100 + 29)

⇒ C.P = (86 × 75)/129

⇒ C.P = 2 × 25 = 50

∴ The correct answer is 50.
